rationale: The replication demonstrates the qualitative mechanism (half-integer meron winding, discontinuous magnitude drop, winding preservation) using a TDGL phase-field surrogate, but does NOT implement the paper's actual methodology: semilocal hybrid polarizations via Wilson-loop HWCC calculations on the tight-binding Haldanium model. The 30% magnitude drop is a phase-field proxy, not the quantized SHP jump in polarization-quantum units. The single meron test omits the full moiré triangulation. While all four sub-claims pass at the mechanism level, the absence of the core SHP/Wilson-loop pipeline means this is a conceptual validation rather than a true computational replication of the paper's specific results.
